1.

Jesus, my Lord, to Bethlehem Thou didst come, Laid in the manger in deep poverty, Wonderful grace and mercy, which Came thus for me, for me!

2.

Jesus, my Saviour, praise be to Thy name! My sins Thou didst bear on the tree of the cross, Hanging there as God’s spotless Lamb, Thou didst die for me, for me!

3.

Jesus, my Shepherd, Thy love doth reach me, Faithfully Thou hast loved Thy lost sheep, Patiently Thou didst seek it year after year, Calling me, yea me!

4.

Jesus, my Shepherd, ascended Thou art, Glory and honour crown Thee there. Faithful Saviour, my heart now teach To look only on Thee, on Thee!

5.

Jesus, my Lord, how blessed Thy comfort, Soon shall I hear Thy lovely voice, Lean me securely against Thy gracious breast At home with Thee, with Thee!
